title: ALiX lifecycle-script allowlist
description: Packages permitted to run install/postinstall scripts. Mirrors the `AllowlistFile` and `AllowlistEntry` interfaces in src/governance/security/supply-chain/dependency-policy.ts, which is the contract the gate actually consumes. This schema is for editor tooling and review; it does not run in CI. The runtime structural check is runLifecycleCheck in the same module.

lastReviewed.description: ISO date of the last full review of this allowlist.

failOnNew.description: Fail when an installed package runs a lifecycle script without an allowlist entry. Keep true.

failOnExpired.description: Fail when an allowlist entry has expired. Keep true.

expiryWindowDays.description: Maximum permitted lifetime of a new entry, in days.

allowDevOnlyScripts.description: Permit lifecycle scripts on dev-only dependencies.

packages.description: Approved packages. A package denied in pnpm-workspace.yaml `allowBuilds` must not appear here.

name.description: Package name, exactly as it appears in the installed tree.

versionRange.description: Semver range the entry covers. A range that no longer includes the installed version silently stops applying.

scripts.description: Lifecycle scripts this entry permits (install, postinstall, preinstall).

reason.description: Why the script is required. Must describe the current dependency, not the dependency at creation time.
